helpIntro: UT Knoxville uses a 4.0 undergraduate scale with plus/minus grades. Enter UT credit hours and final grades to estimate your current, cumulative, projected, or target GPA.
helpNote: For current undergraduate UT coursework. Transfer grades from fall 1985 onward are excluded from the official UT GPA. Graduate, Law, Veterinary Medicine, historical records, and repeat replacement need separate review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 quality points and a 3-credit B earns 9. Together, 21 ÷ 6 = 3.50.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded from GPA until resolved.
gradeExplanations.WF: Withdrew failing; current notation excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: Grade not reported; excluded pending resolution.
gradeExplanations.P: Progress toward thesis/dissertation; not an undergraduate GPA grade; excluded.
gradeExplanations.IW: Incomplete due to writing deficiency; excluded pending resolution.
gradeExplanations.IS: Incomplete satisfactory/no-credit notation; excluded pending resolution.
gradeExplanations.SI: Incomplete satisfactory/no-credit notation; excluded pending resolution.

specialTypes.name: UT Knoxville undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use current undergraduate grades and UT credit hours.

specialTypes.name: Transfer course (fall 1985 or later)
specialTypes.note: Transfer hours may apply to the degree, but transfer grades do not enter the official UT GPA.

specialTypes.name: Historical UT grading period
specialTypes.note: Pre-fall-2006 undergraduate grade values and older incomplete/WF rules differ; use the transcript and Registrar guidance.

specialTypes.name: Graduate, Law, or Veterinary Medicine course/record
specialTypes.note: These records can use different grade sets or repeat rules and should not be calculated with the undergraduate profile.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Confirm eligibility with the current catalog/advisor; do not model a replacement by simply deleting a grade unless your UT record already reflects it.
